title: HoloCity Placement Diff
description: One-way payload: web editor -> Unity importer. The ONLY thing the web editor ever hands back. Transforms are UNITY-SPACE. priorTransform and priorState enable conflict detection and human review; the importer refuses entries whose live scene value no longer matches the prior the session was built on.

baseHash.description: the scene_export baseHash this session loaded. A MISMATCH IS A WARNING, NOT A GATE — it hashes the whole scene, so it trips on any unrelated edit, and making it fatal meant a placement session died to someone adjusting a light. priorTransform/priorState do the real per-entry conflict work.

state.description: Non-transform changes. ONLY the keys present here are applied — an absent key means 'leave it alone', which is not the same as a key set to its default.

priorState.description: The value each key in `state` held at export. Every key in `state` MUST appear here; the importer refuses the entry if the live scene disagrees. A state change with no prior cannot be conflict-checked and is refused rather than trusted.

prefabPath.description: must exist in palette.json; importer instantiates the prefab, never raw meshes

transform.description: ABSOLUTE, including the prefab's axis fix. The web editor seeds an added item with palette.defaultRotation and stores the total, so the importer ASSIGNS this rather than composing with prefab.transform.rotation — composing applied the axis fix twice on ~92% of adds.

state.description: No priorState: a new object has nothing to conflict with.

deleted.description: The importer DEACTIVATES AND REPARENTS to a _PlacerTrash root; it does not destroy. Deletes arrive in batches from a browser session where they were cheap to make, so the wrong one surfaces after a domain reload — exactly when Undo no longer helps.

scale.description: WORLD scale (Unity lossyScale). The importer divides by the parent's lossyScale to get localScale — assigning world scale to localScale multiplies by the parent again and compounds every round trip.

parentId.description: GlobalObjectId of the new parent, or null for the scene root. The importer refuses a parent that is not itself an entry in the session's scene_export, and refuses any reparent that would create a cycle.

layer.description: Layer NAME, never an index. Indices are project-local and a stale index silently lands an object on the wrong layer; a name that does not exist in the project is refused.

tag.description: Tag name. Refused if not defined in the project.

staticFlags.description: StaticEditorFlags by NAME, for the same reason as layer. The full set is sent, not a delta.

materialVariant.description: Key of a variant declared in palette.items[].materialVariants for THIS prefabPath, or null for the prefab default. The importer resolves the key through the palette and never accepts a material path from the diff — the same closed-set rule as prefabPath.
